protocol_stack.prose: OpenMontage (calesthio/OpenMontage, AGPL-3.0) as a chat service: describe a short video, get a plan, say 'Render it', get an MP4 (20-40 s, 1280x720) made only from free material: Wikimedia Commons, NASA and Internet Archive footage, a local Piper voice, generated music and Remotion animation, on CPUs. The planner is the OpenAI-compatible LLM of OPENMONTAGE_LLM_BASE_URL (optional). Chat interface of chatui (docs/celaut/chat.md, revision 6, gRPC over h2c); the files come as image (poster), audio (sound track) and file (video/mp4). Source: https://github.com/celaut-basics/openmontage

network.prose: Open egress, narrowed inside the service. The service reaches the user's LLM endpoint (OPENMONTAGE_LLM_BASE_URL: any host, so it cannot be a hostname tag fixed at pack time) and the free media archives that OpenMontage's stock sources call: commons.wikimedia.org, upload.wikimedia.org, thumb.wikimedia.org, images-api.nasa.gov, images-assets.nasa.gov, archive.org and its file servers *.archive.org (a different host for each item), plus api.pexels.com, videos.pexels.com, images.pexels.com, pixabay.com and cdn.pixabay.com only when PEXELS_API_KEY or PIXABAY_API_KEY is set. Hostname tags cannot serve this: nodo grants the addresses of a hostname and serves no DNS, so an HTTP client fails at the lookup (docs/NETWORKS.md, Hostname tags). The Python process refuses every name lookup outside that list (app/egress.py); FFmpeg, Piper and Chromium read local files only. nodo configures no resolver in the guest, so the service uses public DNS resolvers on port 53 (OPENMONTAGE_DNS_SERVERS replaces them). The LLM API key (OPENMONTAGE_LLM_API_KEY) goes only to the LLM endpoint.
